SELECT s.id, s.season, s.season_sort,
       (SELECT count(*)::int FROM specsheet_revision r
         WHERE r.specsheet_id = s.id
           AND (r.status = 'PUBLISHED'
                OR (SELECT fn_has_perm(fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_specsheet'), 'view_drafts')))) AS revision_count,
       lp.id AS latest_pub_id, fn_rev_label(lp.stage, lp.revision_no) AS latest_pub_label
FROM specsheet s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT r.id, r.stage, r.revision_no FROM specsheet_revision r
   WHERE r.specsheet_id = s.id AND r.status = 'PUBLISHED'
   ORDER BY r.stage_order DESC, r.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT
  (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'number', c.number, 'name', c.name) ORDER BY c.number), '[]'::jsonb)
     FROM component c WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE') AS components,
  (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('material_id', x.material_id, 'name', x.name, 'uom', x.uom,
                                                'thickness', x.thickness, 'variant_count', x.n, 'is_process', x.is_process,
                                                'first_at', x.first_at)
                             ORDER BY x.name, x.thickness NULLS FIRST), '[]'::jsonb)
     FROM (SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.name, m.uom, m.is_process, v.thickness, count(v.id) AS n,
                  extract(epoch FROM min(v.created_at))::bigint AS first_at
             FROM material m
             LEFT JOIN material_variant v ON v.material_id = m.id AND v.status = 'ACTIVE'
            WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.factory_id = fn_user_factory(a.me)
            GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.uom, m.is_process, v.thickness) x) AS materials,
  (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', v.id, 'code', v.code, 'material_id', v.material_id,
                                                'material_name', m.name, 'thickness', v.thickness, 'color', v.color)
                             ORDER BY v.code), '[]'::jsonb)
     FROM material_variant v JOIN material m ON m.id = v.material_id
    WHERE v.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND v.factory_id = fn_user_factory(a.me)) AS variants,
  (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', s.id, 'name', s.name) ORDER BY s.name_key), '[]'::jsonb)

     FROM material_supplier ms JOIN material m ON m.id = ms.material_id
    WHERE m.factory_id = fn_user_factory(a.me)) AS links,
  (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT m.category ORDER BY m.category), '[]'::jsonb)
     FROM material m WHERE m.factory_id = fn_user_factory(a.me)) AS categories,
  (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT m.uom ORDER BY m.uom), '[]'::jsonb)
     FROM material m WHERE m.factory_id = fn_user_factory(a.me)) AS uoms
FROM (SELECT fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'edit_specsheet') AS me) a;

SELECT v.id, fn_article_code_label(v.code) AS code, v.colorway, v.code IS NULL AS no_code, v.spec_status, v.spec_pub_id, v.spec_pub_label, v.spec_pub_stage,
       CASE WHEN pr.drafts THEN v.draft_id END AS draft_id,
       CASE WHEN pr.drafts THEN v.draft_label END AS draft_label,
       coalesce(pr.drafts AND v.draft_stale, false) AS draft_stale,
       v.pub_id, v.pub_label, v.pub_sync,
       CASE WHEN pr.drafts THEN v.draft_spec_label END AS draft_spec_label,
       v.pub_behind
FROM v_cbd_article v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT fn_has_perm(fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd'), 'view_drafts') AS drafts) pr
WHERE fn_can_see_factory((SELECT fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd')), fn_sheet_factory(v.specsheet_id))
  AND v.specsheet_id::text = {{this.params.specsheet_id || ''}}
ORDER BY v.code NULLS LAST, v.colorway;

SELECT v.id, fn_article_code_label(v.code) AS code, v.colorway, v.code IS NULL AS no_code, v.spec_status, v.spec_pub_id, v.spec_pub_label, v.spec_pub_stage,
       CASE WHEN pr.drafts THEN v.draft_id END AS draft_id,
       CASE WHEN pr.drafts THEN v.draft_label END AS draft_label,
       coalesce(pr.drafts AND v.draft_stale, false) AS draft_stale,
       v.pub_id, v.pub_label, v.pub_sync,
       CASE WHEN pr.drafts THEN v.draft_spec_label END AS draft_spec_label,
       v.pub_behind
FROM v_cbd_article v
CROSS JOIN (SELECT fn_has_perm(fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd'), 'view_drafts') AS drafts) pr
WHERE fn_can_see_factory((SELECT fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd')), fn_sheet_factory(v.specsheet_id))
  AND v.specsheet_id::text = {{this.params.specsheet_id || ''}}
ORDER BY v.code NULLS LAST, v.colorway;

SELECT r.id, r.stage, r.stage_order, r.revision_no, r.status, r.sync_status, r.specsheet_revision_id,
       fn_rev_label(sr.stage, sr.revision_no) AS spec_label, r.exchange_rate,
       r.published_at, r.published_by, r.created_at, r.created_by,
       CASE WHEN src_a.id IS NOT NULL THEN fn_article_label(src_a.code, src_a.colorway) END AS source_article, src_sp.season AS source_season, fn_rev_label(src.stage, src.revision_no) AS source_label
FROM cbd_revision r
JOIN specsheet_revision sr ON sr.id = r.specsheet_revision_id
LEFT JOIN cbd_revision src ON src.id = r.source_cbd_revision_id
LEFT JOIN article src_a ON src_a.id = src.article_id
LEFT JOIN specsheet src_sp ON src_sp.id = src_a.specsheet_id
WHERE fn_can_see_factory((SELECT fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd')), fn_article_factory(r.article_id))
  AND r.article_id::text = {{this.params.article_id || ''}}
  AND (r.status = 'PUBLISHED'
       OR (SELECT fn_has_perm(fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd'), 'view_drafts')))
ORDER BY r.stage_order, r.revision_no;

SELECT r.id, r.stage, r.stage_order, r.revision_no, r.status, r.sync_status, r.specsheet_revision_id,
       fn_rev_label(sr.stage, sr.revision_no) AS spec_label, r.exchange_rate,
       r.published_at, r.published_by, r.created_at, r.created_by,
       CASE WHEN src_a.id IS NOT NULL THEN fn_article_label(src_a.code, src_a.colorway) END AS source_article, src_sp.season AS source_season, fn_rev_label(src.stage, src.revision_no) AS source_label
FROM cbd_revision r
JOIN specsheet_revision sr ON sr.id = r.specsheet_revision_id
LEFT JOIN cbd_revision src ON src.id = r.source_cbd_revision_id
LEFT JOIN article src_a ON src_a.id = src.article_id
LEFT JOIN specsheet src_sp ON src_sp.id = src_a.specsheet_id
WHERE fn_can_see_factory((SELECT fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd')), fn_article_factory(r.article_id))
  AND r.article_id::text = {{this.params.article_id || ''}}
  AND (r.status = 'PUBLISHED'
       OR (SELECT fn_has_perm(fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd'), 'view_drafts')))
ORDER BY r.stage_order, r.revision_no;

SELECT g.*, coalesce(pc.master_stale, false) AS master_stale, pc.price_gap, pc.other_colors,
       pc.master_price, pc.master_currency, coalesce(pc.pending, false) AS pending,
       coalesce(pc.can_estimate, false) AS can_estimate
FROM v_cbd_line g
JOIN cbd_revision r ON r.id = g.cbd_revision_id
LEFT JOIN v_cbd_price_check pc ON pc.line_id = g.id
WHERE fn_can_see_factory((SELECT fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd')), fn_cbd_factory(g.cbd_revision_id))
  AND g.cbd_revision_id::text = {{this.params.revision_id || ''}}
  AND (r.status = 'PUBLISHED'
       OR (SELECT fn_has_perm(fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd'), 'view_drafts')))
ORDER BY (g.status <> 'ACTIVE'), g.group_sort, g.comp_no NULLS LAST, g.sort_order;

SELECT g.*, coalesce(pc.master_stale, false) AS master_stale, pc.price_gap, pc.other_colors,
       pc.master_price, pc.master_currency, coalesce(pc.pending, false) AS pending,
       coalesce(pc.can_estimate, false) AS can_estimate
FROM v_cbd_line g
JOIN cbd_revision r ON r.id = g.cbd_revision_id
LEFT JOIN v_cbd_price_check pc ON pc.line_id = g.id
WHERE fn_can_see_factory((SELECT fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd')), fn_cbd_factory(g.cbd_revision_id))
  AND g.cbd_revision_id::text = {{this.params.revision_id || ''}}
  AND (r.status = 'PUBLISHED'
       OR (SELECT fn_has_perm(fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'view_cbd'), 'view_drafts')))
ORDER BY (g.status <> 'ACTIVE'), g.group_sort, g.comp_no NULLS LAST, g.sort_order;

SELECT a.id, fn_article_label(a.code, a.colorway) AS code, a.colorway, sh.season, fn_rev_label(p.stage, p.revision_no) AS label,
       fn_cbd_article_spec_status(a.id) = 'DROPPED' AS dropped,
       pm.name AS model_name, (sh.model_id <> t.model_id) AS is_cross
FROM (SELECT fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'edit_cbd') AS me) x
JOIN article ta ON ta.id::text = {{this.params.article_id || ''}}
JOIN specsheet t ON t.id = ta.specsheet_id AND fn_can_see_factory(x.me, fn_model_factory(t.model_id))
JOIN specsheet sh ON sh.model_id = t.model_id OR sh.model_id = fn_sheet_origin_model(t.id)
JOIN product_model pm ON pm.id = sh.model_id
JOIN article a ON a.specsheet_id = sh.id AND a.id <> ta.id
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT r.stage, r.revision_no FROM cbd_revision r
   WHERE r.article_id = a.id AND r.status = 'PUBLISHED'
   ORDER BY r.stage_order DESC, r.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1
) p ON true
ORDER BY (sh.model_id <> t.model_id), sh.season_sort DESC, a.code;

SELECT a.id, fn_article_label(a.code, a.colorway) AS code, a.colorway, sh.season, fn_rev_label(p.stage, p.revision_no) AS label,
       fn_cbd_article_spec_status(a.id) = 'DROPPED' AS dropped,
       pm.name AS model_name, (sh.model_id <> t.model_id) AS is_cross
FROM (SELECT fn_auth({{appsmith.store.token}}, 'edit_cbd') AS me) x
JOIN article ta ON ta.id::text = {{this.params.article_id || ''}}
JOIN specsheet t ON t.id = ta.specsheet_id AND fn_can_see_factory(x.me, fn_model_factory(t.model_id))
JOIN specsheet sh ON sh.model_id = t.model_id OR sh.model_id = fn_sheet_origin_model(t.id)
JOIN product_model pm ON pm.id = sh.model_id
JOIN article a ON a.specsheet_id = sh.id AND a.id <> ta.id
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT r.stage, r.revision_no FROM cbd_revision r
   WHERE r.article_id = a.id AND r.status = 'PUBLISHED'
   ORDER BY r.stage_order DESC, r.revision_no DESC LIMIT 1
) p ON true
ORDER BY (sh.model_id <> t.model_id), sh.season_sort DESC, a.code;
